title: unleash holes in broken nows who claw through glass eyes in hopes of refactoring a better tomorrow #smallpoems
summary: unleash holes in broken nows who claw through glass eyes in hopes of refactoring a better tomorrow #smallpoems
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
unleash
holes in broken
nows
who claw
through glass
eyes
in hopes of
refactoring
a better tomorrow
#smallpoems
